title: Early-Signing Extension Fee Percentages — TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours
content:
**Extension signing schedule.** The fee percentage of a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours extension depends on how early it is signed: an extension signed at least 60 calendar days before the block's expiry date is charged 5 percent; one signed at least 30 and fewer than 60 days before it, 6 percent; one signed later, the standard extension fee percentage of the block's size. Days are counted from the signing date to the expiry date, the signing date not counted.

| Days from signing to the block's expiry date | Fee percentage |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 5 |
| 30 to 59 | 6 |
| fewer than 30 | the size's extension fee percentage |

Hypothetical cases for a block expiring 31 December: signed 1 November, 60 days, 5 percent; signed 2 November, 59 days, 6 percent; signed 1 December, 30 days, 6 percent; signed 2 December, 29 days, the size's percentage.
